name: app-launch
title: App launch film
description: A 21 second launch film for an app, in six beats: a typed question, a chat bar drawn on by guide lines, a wall of screens, and a closing mark.

props.name: product
props.doc: The product name, typed in the pill and under the app icon.

props.name: mark
props.doc: The product mark: one or two letters, on the button, the app icon and the end mark.

props.name: problem
props.doc: Beat 1: the problem, typed then deleted.

props.name: request
props.doc: Beat 2: what the user types in the chat bar.

props.name: chips
props.doc: Beat 2: the four chips above the bar: what the product can make.

props.name: chipIcons
props.type: hex | tri | diamond | dots | lines | check | flag | mail

props.name: actions
props.doc: Beat 3, third screen: action items as [owner initial, task, due].

props.name: summary.keyLines
props.doc: Which transcript lines (index, 1 = first after the comment) the scan picks out.

props.name: summary.bullets
props.doc: What those lines become on the summary card.

props.name: summary.owners
props.doc: The owners' names under their avatars.

props.name: summary.sent
props.doc: The message the recap folds into.

props.name: transcript
props.doc: Beat 3, first screen: the lines that type on (up to 15; the first is a comment).

props.name: cards
props.doc: Beat 3, second screen: card label, big figure, small figure, chip figure.

props.name: palette
props.doc: The glow under every beat: a RiseGlow palette.

props.name: accent
props.doc: The mark on the app icon.
